text.KJV NEH 12:34: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
text.BHSA NEH 12:35: וּמִבְּנֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בַּחֲצֹצְרֹ֑ות זְכַרְיָ֨ה בֶן־יֹֽונָתָ֜ן בֶּן־שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה בֶּן־מַתַּנְיָה֙ בֶּן־מִ֣יכָיָ֔ה בֶּן־זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן־אָסָֽף׃
text.KJV NEH 12:35: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:
text.BHSA NEH 12:36: וְֽאֶחָ֡יו שְֽׁמַעְיָ֡ה וַעֲזַרְאֵ֡ל מִֽלֲלַ֡י גִּֽלֲלַ֡י מָעַ֞י נְתַנְאֵ֤ל וִֽיהוּדָה֙ חֲנָ֔נִי בִּכְלֵי־שִׁ֥יר דָּוִ֖יד אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעֶזְרָ֥א הַסֹּופֵ֖ר לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
text.KJV NEH 12:36: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.

B.name: Shemaiah
B.line: Grandfather of the priest Zechariah, in the trumpeters' genealogy
family: son-of mattaniah-12 (Mattaniah, Levite ancestor of Zechariah the trumpeter, named in Nehemia)

why: The Hebrew genealogy identifies Shemaiah as Jonathan’s father, Mattaniah’s son, and Zechariah’s grandfather, matching B. A instead assigns him the Mattaniah of 2 Chronicles 29:13, from Hezekiah’s much earlier period, incompatible with A’s stated activity under Ezra.
